summary: ICICI Bank Limited filed a Form 6-K reporting routine board decisions: the re-appointment of an independent director and the convening of the 32nd Annual General Meeting. No special-situation transaction such as an acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring is involved. The filing is a standard foreign issuer report under Rule 13a-16, containing no deal terms, premiums, or advisory roles. The re-appointment of Ms. Vibha Paul Rishi and AGM details are ordinary governance matters. As this is not a special situation, no further analysis is warranted.
